title: unified-rollouts: improve canary/AB/shadow autorollback workflow and observability
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation: we've had a few incidents where canary/AB/shadow rollouts did not rollback automatically when regression signals crossed thresholds (root causes: noisy metric aggregation and race conditions in the abort path). This PR consolidates the autorollback controller, tightens metric quorum logic, and improves observability and safety guards for staged shadow/canary/AB rollouts.

What this PR does: consolidates the rollout autorollback engine (controller/handler) so canary, AB and shadow modes share a single decision path; adds metric quorum to reduce noise-driven rollbacks; ensures rollback actions are idempotent and race-free; surfaces clearer rollback reasons in tracing and debug logs; and adds telemetry to track rollback latency and action counts.

Key changes: single autorollback controller (pkg/rollout/autorollback), metric-quorum evaluation (pkg/rollout/metrics/quorum.go), improved tracer spans and tags for rollback decisions (observability package), canary/AB policy normalization to avoid double-evaluations, and e2e + integration tests for staged-shadow workflows.

Rollout plan: feature branch validated in staging with traffic shadowing for internal beta. Canary and AB behaviors are backward compatible by default. New quorum defaults to conservative values and can be overridden via rollout spec.

Rollback triggers and thresholds (defaults):
- composite_error_rate > 5% over 3m AND quorum >= 3 hosts
- latency_p90 delta > 200ms over baseline AND quorum >= 3 hosts
- custom regression metric breach (user-defined) with quorum check

Safety guards:
- manual quarantine stage support (operator can pause and quarantine new variants)
- exponential backoff for repeated rollouts to avoid churn
- debug-mode flag that emits full decision snapshots to tracing for 1% of rollouts (off by default)

Testing done: unit tests for quorum logic and idempotent rollbacks, integration tests simulating concurrent rollback signals, e2e test that exercises staged shadow -> canary -> abort flow, and load test verifying controller scales without causing SLO regressions.

Documentation: updated rollout spec docs (docs/rollouts/autorollback.md) with examples for AB, canary and shadow modes and recommended defaults.

Checklist:
- [x] Controller refactor and unit tests
- [x] Quorum logic implemented and tested
- [x] Observability: metrics, traces, logs
- [x] Integration/E2E tests
- [x] Docs updated

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps default behavior conservative to avoid surprise rollbacks. Customers who want more aggressive autorollbacks should explicitly set quorum and thresholds in their rollout specs. Related Linear items: ENG-4823 (autorollback refactor) and ENG-4890 (observability for rollouts).

review_comments: Ethan Clarke: Great consolidation — one thing: can you explain why quorum default is 3? I worry it may be too high for small clusters.

Priya Menon: Default chosen to balance noise reduction vs rollout agility. Added note in docs explaining how to tune for small clusters and lowered default to prefer stability for managed customers. Owners can override per-rollout.
Samir Patel: Found a potential race in controller reconcile when two abort signals come in simultaneously. Please ensure CompareAndSwap on rollout state or use leader-elected queue.
Priya Menon: Addressed with atomic state transitions and added integration test simulating concurrent aborts (integration/rollouts/concurrent_abort_test.go).
Marta Alvarez: Observability looks solid. Please ensure trace spans include the rollout id and policy name. Approving after small comment on log verbosity.
